producer_report.summary: athena.toml now pins [tools.sccache] 0.10.0 and sets RUSTC_WRAPPER ({athena_home}/tools/sccache/0.10.0/bin/sccache), SCCACHE_DIR ({athena_home}/sccache) and CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 in both the change and study envs. CARGO_TARGET_DIR and CARGO_TERM_COLOR are untouched. The config.rs pin test now reads the pin from athena.toml and strips it with replacen to check the optional case and the no-sha256 rule. A new test checks the wrapper path matches the pinned version in both capabilities. CHANGELOG and a new D80 in docs/decisions.md record the wiring, mark D79's deferred step done, and say the speedup is not measured. No change was needed to env.rs, paths.rs, xtask or README: {athena_home} was already supported and they describe the pin generally.

checks_run.note: every test result line shows 0 failed

open_issues: The sccache binary must be installed through setup before jobs run with this config, or builds fail because the wrapper is missing.
mistakes: I first ran cargo test without -q, so the output was truncated and I had to rerun it.
learnings: REPO_CONFIG in config.rs is include_str of athena.toml, so those tests read the real file.
Capabilities is a BTreeMap keyed by id.
